body:
We locked an initial product shape from your engineering brief (demand meeting).

Structured outcome:
{
  "ceo_summary": "This initiative is crucial for elevating our deployment reliability by ensuring robust, automated smoke testing across all repository changes.",
  "constraints": [
    "* Implement the HTTP echo server with minimal dependencies to minimize build footprint.",
    "* Ensure structured logging (e.g., JSON format) is used for all verification steps.",
    "* The solution must be easily integrable into existing CI/CD workflows (e.g., via a simple command).",
    "* Verification must cover critical paths (smoke tests) efficiently.",
    "* The solution must maintain performance characteristics suitable for CI execution time limits."
  ],
  "cpo_summary": "We will prioritize a lightweight implementation focusing on minimal overhead and structured logging to ensure this verification layer is fast, reliable, and easily integrated into our existing CI framework.",
  "modality": "cli_tool",
  "rationale": "A CLI tool or a dedicated library function is the most appropriate modality as the task involves extending repository coverage and setting up a minimal, self-contained verification mechanism (HTTP echo server), which is typically invoked within a CI pipeline."
}

---
Questions for you (reply via Staff Mail in the IDE when you are at the console):
· Does the chosen modality match how you imagine shipping this?
· Any hard UX/product constraints we should treat as non-negotiable?
· What success looks like for v1 (one sentence)?
subject: Design checkpoint — product modality & constraints
